items.t: Crescent Beach and Ocean Park: 107 houses sold at a median of $1,745,000, with the middle half between $1,482,500 and $2,137,000. The median house took 26 days to sell and closed at 95.9% of list.

13 townhomes sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park at a median of $824,000 (middle half $680,000 to $1,000,000). A typical townhome in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park spent 35 days on the market and closed at 96.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 4 Duplexes also sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Crescent Beach and Ocean Park compares with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock

items.t: Of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Crescent Beach and Ocean Park ranks 4th highest at $1,745,000; the range is $1,345,000 (King George Corridor) to $2,280,000 (Elgin Chantrell). Pacific Douglas ($1,593,000) sits just below and Grandview ($1,782,500) sits just above.

Townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park have the 6th highest median of 8 South Surrey and White Rock sub-areas, $824,000. King George Corridor is lowest at $776,000 and Elgin Chantrell highest at $1,242,500. Morgan Creek ($785,000) sits just below and Pacific Douglas ($825,000) sits just above.
